messages:
alex: RFC follow-up: propose probe-first shed flow for regional overloads. probe small sample of candidate regions before preempting to lower tier.

morgan: is this policy-level or runtime?

alex: policy emits `shed_decision` with candidates + probe_seed; runtime runs probe and reports result.

sana: telemetry must include probe_target, rtt_ms, and result. don't mix with normal histograms.

jake: add tags: shed.probe_target, shed.probe_rtt_ms, shed.probe_result. runtime also needs probe_concurrency limit.

ops-bot: example policy snippet:
```yaml
policy:
  name: probe_first_shed_v1
  params:
    probe_sample_rate: 0.05
    probe_timeout_ms: 150
    soft_hold_ms: 200
    preempt_slots: 3
    per_tenant_preempt_cap: 1
```

morgan: fairness: allocate preempt slots round-robin across tenants, fallback to queued best-effort if cap reached.
sana: probes must backoff on failures; default exponential backoff. dashboards should show probe success by region and alert <60% over 5m.
jake: API: RouteDecision -> add `shed_action` enum {NONE, PROBE, PREEMPT, FALLBACK} and `probe_seed` for deterministic sims. older clients ignore new fields.

alex: control-plane panic short-circuits probes. skip probes if region_health[target] < 0.2.
morgan: rollout checklist: 1% canary, telemetry smoke, sim replay, ramp, SLA watch 24h.
sana: doc note: probe_result values TIMEOUT/SUCCESS/BACKPRESSURE.
jake: will add probe qps cap (e.g., 50 qps per region).
alex: i'll open RFC PR with API changes, sim harness updates, and dashboard samples.
morgan: LGTM
sana: thanks :thumbsup:
jake: thanks all
